item.title: Roadside drug testing is step forward for Wisconsin road safety
item.description: The Wisconsin Legislature recently approved of law enforcement to issue saliva tests to detect drugged driving. Officers have been permitted to use breathalyzers to measure a driver’s blood alcohol concentration, but no legislation was introduced to allow tests that detect drugs until this March.
